scope: Azure-first provider validation of App Service and Functions hosting plans. No provisioning or business workflow.
observations: Azure rejected P0v3 and EP1 with SubscriptionIsOverQuotaForSku in westus2, eastus2 and canadacentral. Both limits were zero; each plan requires one instance.
Subscription quota is an environment constraint. These observations do not define universal rejection of valid hosting plans.
Resource group and deployment record absence verified on both targets.
